name: Nutmeg
siboNotes: Nutmeg is FODMAP-free and generally well-tolerated in typical culinary amounts. Use sparingly as excessive amounts can cause digestive upset.
preparationTips: Use freshly grated whole nutmeg for best flavor and potency
Add at the end of cooking to preserve aromatic compounds
Store whole nutmeg in airtight container for up to 4 years
A little goes a long way - start with small pinches
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants and anti-inflammatory compounds
Provides small amounts of copper and magnesium
Traditional digestive aid in small amounts
